findings.title: Local .env missing keys from template
findings.description: Keys documented in the environment template are absent from the local .env.
findings.impact: Processes that read these variables may crash or behave incorrectly at runtime.
findings.remediation: Add the missing keys to .env (and to your deploy host): SESSION_SECRET

findings.title: .env is not ignored
findings.description: Gitignore rules (including nested files and negation) do not ignore `.env`.
findings.evidence: Checked 1 gitignore file(s). Tracked secret probes: .env, .env.local, .env.development, .env.production, .env.development.local, config/.env.
findings.impact: API keys and credentials may enter git history and deploy artifacts.
findings.remediation: Add `.env` and `.env.*` to .gitignore (keep `.env.example` tracked with a negation if needed).

findings.title: No lockfile found
findings.description: A Node project without a lockfile produces non-reproducible installs on deploy hosts.
findings.evidence: Checked for package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, bun.lock, bun.lockb — none present.
findings.impact: Production dependency trees can diverge from local installs and break builds.
findings.remediation: Commit the lockfile for your package manager (npm, pnpm, yarn, or bun).

findings.title: Hardcoded listen port
findings.description: The process appears to bind a fixed port instead of reading PORT from the environment.
findings.impact: Hosts that inject PORT (Heroku, Render, many containers) will fail health checks or refuse to bind.
findings.remediation: Bind to `process.env.PORT` (or equivalent) and keep a local default only as fallback.

findings.title: Services missing healthcheck
findings.description: Some services do not declare a healthcheck. Depends_on conditions and load balancers may not wait for readiness.
findings.impact: Dependent services may start against an unready upstream.
findings.remediation: Add a `healthcheck` block (or platform probe) for each long-running service that accepts traffic.

findings.title: No HEALTHCHECK instruction
findings.description: Without HEALTHCHECK (or an equivalent platform health probe), orchestrators may route traffic to an unhealthy container.
findings.impact: Failed processes can remain in rotation until a manual restart.
findings.remediation: Add a HEALTHCHECK that probes your app's readiness endpoint, or configure an equivalent probe on your host.

findings.title: No non-root USER
findings.description: Running the process as root increases blast radius if the container is compromised.
findings.evidence: No USER instruction selecting a non-root user.
findings.impact: Privilege escalation risk inside the container namespace.
findings.remediation: Create a non-root user in the image and add `USER` before the final CMD/ENTRYPOINT.

findings.title: No Node version pin
findings.description: No .nvmrc, .node-version, or engines.node was found to pin the runtime.
findings.impact: CI and hosts may use a different Node major than developers.
findings.remediation: Add an .nvmrc (or engines.node) matching the version you test against.

findings.title: No start or build script
findings.description: Many platforms invoke npm start or npm run build. Neither script is defined.
findings.impact: Platforms that expect start/build may fail or fall back to unpredictable defaults.
findings.remediation: Add a "start" and/or "build" script appropriate for your runtime, or document the custom start command in your platform config.

findings.title: engines.node not declared
findings.description: No engines.node field was found. Hosts may pick a Node version that does not match local development.
findings.impact: Subtle runtime mismatches between local and production Node versions.
findings.remediation: Add "engines": { "node": ">=20" } (or your required range) and pin the same version in your host settings.

findings.title: No EXPOSE instruction
findings.description: EXPOSE is documentation for the published port. Its absence is not always a failure, but platforms may misconfigure port mapping.
findings.impact: Operators may guess the wrong container port.
findings.remediation: Add `EXPOSE <port>` matching the port your process listens on.

findings.title: Dockerfile found
findings.description: Inspected Dockerfile for common deployment pitfalls.
